hero.pill: Ben Nguyen · Product & Digital Designer, Auckland
hero.title: I design digital products and websites that are easy to use.
hero.lead: I have spent more than ten years designing websites, customer portals and apps for agencies, small businesses and my own products, with campaign and print work along the way.

services.heading: There are three ways we can work together.

items.title: Projects
items.body: Websites, apps and landing pages, from the first brief through to launch. I start with the people who will use it and how the content is organised, before any visual design.
list: Visual design for desktop and mobile
Developer handover and a check of the build before launch
items.start: A free call to talk through what you need, then a fixed quote.

items.title: Monthly design
items.body: For small teams who need a designer most weeks, but not forty hours of one. You get a set number of hours each month for whatever comes up, from someone who already knows your brand.
list: Email newsletters, social posts and ads
Brochures, flyers and other print work
Small changes to an existing app or portal
items.start: A free call to agree the hours and how requests come through.

items.title: Small jobs
items.body: One landing page, an ad set, a brochure, a book cover or a pack design, with a clear brief and a quick turnaround.
list: Send the brief and any brand files you have
Agree a fixed price before any work starts
Receive files ready for print or the web
items.start: Email the brief, or book a free call if it needs talking through.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Ben.
paragraphs: I am a product and digital designer with more than ten years of experience. I spent six years at Avidly, an APAC HubSpot partner, the last four leading design on websites, customer portals and web apps for clients across New Zealand and Australia.
Since July 2025 I have worked for myself, designing for small businesses and shipping my own iOS apps, including SoundLax.
I have designed for HubSpot, WordPress, Wix and Squarespace, so I know how a design will be built and plan it to be practical for developers from the start.

cta.heading: Have a project in mind?
cta.body: Tell me what you are working on. The first call is free, and I will give you a straight answer on what it would take.

footer.blurb: Bentoji is the design practice of Ben Nguyen, a product and digital designer in Auckland.
